verdict.rationale: LiteLLM is an LLM gateway/proxy with an admin UI. A built-in assistant is a fair question for this kind of product, so the axis applies. The evidence documents routing, cost tracking, an MCP Gateway and a memory store, but nothing describes an in-product AI assistant that users can delegate tasks to. The MCP Gateway and memory features are adjacent building blocks, not a built-in assistant, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
